name: Emoji & Icon Studio by Kairesh
releaseNotes:
v2.8.0 Master Studio & Host Update!
• Fixed Premiere Pro 'ERROR: Please select or open a Composition first' completely
• Host-Specific Defaults: Native Vector Shape Layers for After Effects, Ultra-Crisp 1024px PNG for Premiere Pro
• Auto-creates 'Icons' bin in Premiere Pro and 'Icons' folder in After Effects Project panel
• MediaFetch PNG / JPG / SVG format selector for clipboard image paste
• Fixed Update Modal z-index: popups now reliably display in front of settings drawer
• One-click update inside the plugin
